description: Réseau TPG - Arrêts is a dataset listed in Swiss national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Transports publics genevois TPG. Les arrêts sont les points de montées et de descentes des passagers sur le réseau de transport collectif genevois. Les points arrêts portant le même nom, mais pour des lignes différentes se superposent. Visuellement, on ne distingue qu'un seul point mais il peux y en avoir plusieurs. Coverage: Switzerland. The portal files it under the publisher Transports publics genevois TPG. It offers 9 resource(s) in API, CSV, GML, KML, SHP. The portal shows 2026-09-26 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is opendata.swiss terms of use: open use. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ch-portal.
